task: Memory OS CLI Extensions & Prompt Context Injection
resolution: Extended the main memos.py CLI with search, user-memory, and context commands for unified agent execution. Updated SystemPromptBuilder to query User-OS memories and inject them into the system prompt using a dependency-free YAML formatter while strictly filtering out developer codebase/symbol references.
lessons_learned: Consolidating CLI search and database management under a single entry point simplifies agent interaction, and dependency-free formatters prevent external packaging overhead.

task: Phase 3 Audit Logging & Process Hijacking Fix
hurdles_regression: Importing db_exporter inside unit tests triggers utils.setup_and_run_venv which relaunches the script using a subprocess, causing process hijacking and ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scraper' due to missing root directory in sys.path.
resolution: Mocked scraper.utils.setup_and_run_venv as a no-op at the top of the test suite before importing any routes or db_exporter classes, preventing process hijacking. Completed all audit logging integrations across governance, credentials, briefs, videos, and scraper blueprints, and verified that all 239 unit/integration tests pass.
lessons_learned: When modules execute environment setup code or spawn subprocesses during import, tests must mock those setup helpers at the very beginning of the test execution lifecycle to avoid process hijacking.

task: Updated Global Roadmap with Completed Phase 2 and 3 Items
resolution: Checked off completed Phase 2 Cost & Quota Dashboard, and Phase 3 Evidence & OSINT features (Artifact Store, Timestamp & Hash Verification, Evidence Bundle Export, and Retention Locks) in the global roadmap.
lessons_learned: Keeping the roadmap accurate and up-to-date helps coordinate future developer and agent workstreams.

hurdles_regression: Expected source_id' must be a positive integer error message instead of Watcher 'source_id' is required in test loop check when source_id is missing.
resolution: Created configs/watchers.config.json with primary/secondary watcher configurations. Implemented validate_watcher_config(payload) in governance.py verifying watcher fields, source ID, positive integers, enabled flag, runs per day, cost limits, and crawl interval boundaries (min 15 mins to prevent rate limit overheating). Covered with scratch/test_watchers_config.py unit test.
lessons_learned: Validating configuration limits and crawl intervals before scheduling background watchers ensures runtime safety and avoids unexpected rate-limit exhaustion.

resolution: Implemented execute_watchers(root_dir) in governance.py which parses configs/watchers.config.json, filters enabled watchers, runs validation check, logs runs in connector_runs, and logs watcher.run event in audit_events using the same transaction connection. Covered with scratch/test_watchers_runner.py unit test.
lessons_learned: Batching watcher execution steps and maintaining connection passing avoids database locking issues and guarantees atomic operation states.

hurdles_regression: Dashboard page rendered empty after Compact Grid/widget refactor. Root causes found: invalid escaped JS template ticks in widgets.js, default restore using unstable youtube-metrics widget, and no containment for one widget throwing during mount.
resolution: Removed escaped template ticks, changed default workspace restore to stable channel-analytics plus minified-stats, guarded readLocal to return arrays only, restored defaults when saved state filters to zero valid widgets, wrapped widget.mount in an error boundary, and falls back to defaults if all valid saved widgets fail to mount.
lessons_learned: Dashboard restore must be resilient to stale saved layouts and partially broken widgets; JS syntax checks plus small static regression tests catch high-blast-radius frontend failures when browser automation is unavailable.

hurdles_regression: The youtube-metrics widget in the sidebar palette still used broken APIs after the blank-dashboard fallback fix: it accessed this.element before BaseWidget.mount assigned it, called nonexistent bindDateSync/getWidgetDateHTML, referenced window.state.channels instead of state.allChannels, and called nonexistent workspace.saveLayout.
resolution: Rebuilt YouTubeMetricsWidget as a stable Main Analytics widget using BaseWidget.afterMount, renderDateSyncMenu, imported initChartUI/renderActiveChart, state.allChannels, workspace.save, ResizeObserver redraw, and guarded serialization. Removed dead getWidgetDateHTML helper and added static regression checks for the old bad API patterns.
lessons_learned: Palette widgets need the same API-contract coverage as restored widgets; otherwise a fixed default layout can still be broken by user-created widgets.

hurdles_regression: web_app.py startup failed after editable install because app/state.py imported news_scraper.db_client while the repo only contained and packaged the scraper implementation package.
resolution: Added a news_scraper compatibility namespace that exposes the scraper package path, included it in setuptools package discovery, and added a regression test for the app's namespace imports.
lessons_learned: Package names, implementation package names, and documented import namespaces must stay compatible; a small namespace shim is safer than rewriting scattered imports when both contracts are already in use.

task: Governance and Admin Endpoint Regression Fixes
hurdles_regression: Full tests failed because Phase 4 governance functions and admin quota endpoints were missing, the scraper blueprint was unregistered, and proposal workflow validation still used the older memos name.
resolution: Restored audit logging helper, watcher config validation, watcher execution, admin quota/system metrics routes, scraper blueprint registration, and memory_os proposal workflow handling while preserving migration-safe SQLite behavior.
lessons_learned: Phase feature slices must keep service exports, route registration, UI endpoint contracts, and test workflow names aligned; otherwise compile can pass while integration tests lose core surfaces.

task: Review Queue and Retention Contract Fixes
hurdles_regression: Frontend code referenced /api/governance/review-queue endpoints that returned 404, and scripts/manage.py retention imported purge_expired_data which no longer existed.
resolution: Added draft brief listing/status updates, review queue approve/reject routes, retention purge service, and focused regression tests using an isolated governance database.
lessons_learned: Frontend route references and CLI imports need direct smoke coverage; full unit suites can pass while UI-only endpoints or rarely used commands are missing.

hurdles_regression: Broad GET smoke found /api/scraper/proposals and /api/scraper/tasks returning 500 because ScraperOrchestrator called MemoryOS(db_path) with the path as the config positional argument.
resolution: Changed ScraperOrchestrator to call MemoryOS(db_path=resolved_db_path), store root/db path, and reinitialize its singleton only when the requested root or db changes. Added route and constructor regression tests.
lessons_learned: Smoke route tests catch lazy constructor contract drift that normal unit discovery misses; singleton services need explicit reconfiguration guards for temp-root tests and multi-root route checks.
